title: Complete far-retimed E8 replay and coupled bit frames; conditional kappa 0.000998634658090835
body:
The retimed complex unit in #384 has a stronger nine-stage moment, but its description explicitly leaves the certificate-specific splice, dirty scalar/lifetime, new Clifford-frame and local finite-invoice checks unrerun. This change supplies those fresh checks in #377's complete physical construction, composes it with a fully invoiced zero-entrance bit word, and records the conditional result in the README and a checked candidate certificate.

**Conditional κ = 998634658090834606116833 / 1000000000000000000000000000 = 0.000998634658090834606116833.** It exceeds the pinned three-round #387 witness `998634657132636/10^18` (803b139) by `9.58198606116833e-13`. This small headline gain applies applecrusher's #376 assembly refinement to the freshly replayed stronger complex supplier. It is not attributed to the new bit frames, and it is not a measured runtime improvement.

## Change and mathematical scope

- **Complete replay for #384's changed complex unit.** Replays Sussman's reference/mirror checks, flipped-sign and source-span controls, and the rational operator on all 1,023 registers. Derives a separate #377 work tree following Rohan Arun's #385 procedure, with a digest for every certificate/pin/census/expected-price change. Fresh dirty scalar maps, lifetimes, exact Clifford recipes, data/cover phases, emitted global template, finite invoice and independent two-engine audit pass. No checker algorithm or control is removed.
- **Connected bit frame coalescence.** After #376's R=822 helper reuse, a deterministic search coalesces connected one-, two- and three-gate groups. Seventy accepted moves change 98 distinct scalar-gate frames, preserving scalar order, operands, copied totals, endpoints and helper count. The bit coarse saving increases from `8128527708459/8000000000000000` to `63613071872999/62500000000000000`. An exact rational Taylor/log bound proves the cost decrease, including fallback charges, for `0.998 <= p <= 0.9999`; no all-exponent dominance is claimed.
- **Fully checked unsplit bit B3.** Uses #381's generalized checkers at K=3, h=8, T=7: m=56, stock=10794, max child=34, least halving degree two, row reserve=6274<20161. Replays all 1,062 local and 1,542 global dirty columns, all 120 port geometries and rational routes, literal banks, and word/record/omitted-bridge controls. The fresh finite coefficient is `56346946940397<2^80`, with power bound `q^3137`.
- **Honest baseline and record update.** The unchanged #376 bit word also exceeds the new complex cap, so it reaches the same refined κ. This equality and the separate bit component gain are mandatory checks. Eight bootstrap steps, η=10^-24, β=10^-18 (the smaller positive backoff from #387), fresh coefficient-dependent cutoffs, all 47 exact outer inequalities, adjacent 10^-27 tick rejection complex-cap rejection, and zero-eta/zero-beta/unit-beta rejection are checked. README/candidate/contributor records distinguish this submitted candidate from the maintainer-reviewed selected result.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/e8-coupled-bit-retiming/requirements.txt
make e8-coupled-verify
```

The command requires a fresh output directory and first runs the **entire pinned #375 supplier suite**, including its historical p=10 and E8 regressions. It then regenerates the selected bit word, runs the **entire original eight-stage #377 suite**, and runs the changed complex component's physical/Clifford/invoice checks. It compares the final reconstructed result with a frozen expected record; stored PASS receipts do not substitute for execution. Every imported byte has a source commit/path/SHA-256, and the verifier rechecks package integrity before and after execution.

- Fresh local #375, #377, changed #384 component and both bit words: passed.
- Full packaged replay from a fresh output directory on Python 3.13: **passed on the final head `b3c45822ca847aec8c0c019bb04db30881fc2966`**, including both original supplier suites, the changed complex unit, the new bit word, both moment engines, all finite invoices, exact record equality and final manifest checks.
- `make gen4-bank-verify`: passed, all nine historical audited stages.
- Historical joint-dual full dirty replay/profile/assembly: passed; `tests/test_joint_reclaim.py`: 16 tests and 72 subtests passed. Three metadata files refresh the stale README/Makefile source pins and derived digests following #318; mathematical values are unchanged.
- `make verify` was attempted on Windows and stopped at the existing `resource` module dependency in the first historical group. The final head passed both dedicated Linux full-replay jobs on **Python 3.13 and 3.14**, including record checks and `git diff --exit-code`: [workflow and downloadable verification artifacts](https://github.com/ai-nanachi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119853376). The repository's broader historical Linux matrix **passed all 52 jobs** on the same final head: [complete matrix](https://github.com/ai-nanachi/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119853377).
- `git diff --check` and candidate-record/source-manifest checks: passed.

The upstream workflows require a maintainer to authorize this first-time contributor's workflow runs; the dedicated upstream run is [awaiting that authorization](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/38119919296). The successful fork runs above execute the submitted workflow on the exact PR head. This PR is ready for review; numerical verification does not imply maintainer approval or acceptance of the retained mathematical interfaces.

## Scope and attribution

Finite **conditional** witness. The upstream all-size affine/compiler/chart interfaces, recursive rank-cost realization, compressed Clifford windows and arbitrary dirty correlated banks, fixed tapes, precision/recovery, routing, restored-row and analytic transfer remain assumptions. No Lean proof of the complete multiplication theorem or astronomical cover enumeration is claimed. The proof note states the degree-two interface explicitly.

Credits: Dylan Crow / utcorvusvolat-dotcom (#370 bit); applecrusher (#376 reuse and exact refinement); DaysSky (#363/#373/#375 bridged chronology/full replay and #381 unsplit halving); Zhihao Chen / jacklightChen (#377 complete complex component); Chafik Boukhalfa / chafreaky (#378/#384 far-retimed unit); Rohan Arun (#380 common envelope, #385 derived physical replay and #387 smaller-beta witness); DreamingOfClouds (#315 retained interfaces); Jacob Sussman (E8 unit, certificates and checkers); Henry Grant, Evan McKinney, eumemic, Avi Eisenberg, icekylinx, RaD and the predecessor contributors retained in the original notices.

The included 25-trial campaign, five-family exploration and negative results explain the new bounded search without claiming worldwide priority. Prepared by ai-nanachi with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New code is Apache-2.0; source-specific licenses/notices are preserved.
